proof:
change ∀ T E L : ℕ, 0 < E → T < L → ∃ j : ℕ, L ≤ T + j * E ∧ T + j * E < L + E
intro T E L hE hTL
let a := L - T - 1
have ha : T + a + 1 = L := by
  dsimp [a]
  omega
have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div a E
have hmod := Nat.mod_lt a hE
rw [Nat.mul_comm E (a / E)] at hdiv
refine ⟨a / E + 1, ?_⟩
rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
constructor <;> omega
